# llms.txt — krmaazha AI Resume Review & Tailoring Tool
# Learn more: https://llmstxt.org

## Overview
krmaazha is an AI-powered resume review and tailoring service built by Kumail Raza, an AI and data engineer based in Karachi, Pakistan. The service uses a 5-agent AI pipeline to analyze job posts, profile hiring managers, map candidate skills, write tailored resumes, and compose outreach messages.

## Services
- $5 Resume Review — a live 15-minute audit of your resume with a fix list
- Single Role — $75 for one tailored resume, outreach message, and analysis brief
- 5-Role Package — $300 for five tailored resumes with priority 24-hour turnaround
- Weekly Sprint — $600 for 7 days of unlimited tailoring

## How It Works
1. Post Analyzer — extracts role requirements, tech stack, tone, and urgency from job posts
2. Psychology Profiler — identifies the hiring manager's communication style and persuasion angles
3. Profile Matcher — maps your skills against requirements, ranks experience, extracts ATS keywords
4. Resume Writer — generates tailored resumes in paragraph format with strict anti-AI writing rules
5. Message Composer — writes platform-adapted outreach messages (LinkedIn, Upwork, email)
